Build clean, exit 0. Two real bugs, not noise, hid in that log:

- `src/core/options.js` — `resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — `isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined` (new config loader leaves unset flags undefined, old one gave `false`). Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

Rest was deprecation/dedupe noise from bump, no action needed.
